title: Prove acceptance evaluation works on installed Execution Observability builds before policy re-enabling
outcome: Prove acceptance evaluation works on installed Execution Observability builds before policy re-enabling
acceptance: On installed builds, a real evaluation of a disposable task using the complete shared source_id records and passes, and done on the unchanged source with an explicit current SourceId consumes that evaluation and records a completion seal. Record the actual evidence and build identities, and label any asserted fixture inputs explicitly.

After an actual source change, evaluation of that disposable task is refused or voided. Missing verdicts or refused evidence never become passes. Record the actual source-change and refusal or voiding evidence.
Keep operational evaluation policy OFF; make no live policy change or alteration of existing evaluations as part of this proof.

completion.summary: Proved installed real independent SourceId evaluation, successful unchanged-source completion and seal, and changed-source completion refusal; operational evaluation remains OFF.
